entities.name: Allama Khalid Mahmood
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dr Allama Khalid Maḥmūd was a Pakistani Sunni Islamic scholar who served as a Justice of the Supreme Court of Pakistan. He established the Islamic Academy and City Jamia Masjid in Manchester, England, and was best known for his works related to the Finality of the Prophethood.
